description: This source file defines a custom JSP tag (StoreFooterlTag) that outputs the footer content for a store page, including the store's name and operating years.

classes.name: StoreFooterlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class for rendering store footer information such as the store name and operational years.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the store footer content, including business years and store name, during the start tag processing.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Indicates the end of the custom tag processing, returning EVAL_PAGE.
